title: Abbie's World Studio — command dictionary for MCP
purpose: Inventory of world/scene operations ChatGPT (or any agent) should eventually call via MCP while conversing with Evan. Target: auto-generate scene data from chat, upsert the live world document, and reflect it in Studio + iPad.

flow: ChatGPT (Zeus / dungeon master) has full editor access to the world API
Household can create many worlds; player, Studio, and Zeus can set focus (world.set_current)
Also reads/writes live session JSON (HUD, beat, flags) for real-time household play
Counters/gates via vars.apply — server calculates; GPT never invents totals
May propose SwiftUI overlays that mount into World 2 chrome (see GPT_DUNGEON_MASTER_PRIMER.md)
ChatGPT proposes a scene (name, summary, plate URL or prompt, song idea, places)
MCP upserts that scene into the focused world document with expectedRevision
Studio reloads / shows the graph; Save is either the MCP upsert itself or a confirm step
iPad offers What's new on the new revision; live patches fan out without a full world rewrite
northStar.documentOfRecord: World2WorldDocument — many per household; /worlds/current is the focused one (PRD multi-world)
northStar.liveDocument: Small session JSON (revisioned patches) per focused worldId — see GPT_DUNGEON_MASTER_PRIMER.md §3

mcpSuitabilityScale.ready: Callable today as a thin MCP tool over existing HTTP or a small Studio bridge
mcpSuitabilityScale.shape_ok: Clear tool shape; needs a thin server or Studio bridge (not exposed as agent API yet)
mcpSuitabilityScale.ui_only: Exists in Studio UI; extract to API before MCP
mcpSuitabilityScale.planned: Specified in PRD / product intent; not shipped
mcpSuitabilityScale.unsuitable: Human/GUI or external product — keep out of MCP or wrap carefully

commands.intent: Load the live world document the iPad will play

commands.chatgptRole: Commit agent-built graph; server preserves players; 409 → reload and retry
commands.notes: Studio collectLiveDocument() is the reference serializer. Never drop players.

commands.intent: Return editor-friendly summary of the loaded world
commands.transport: Derived from world.get_current + Studio lintWorld(); not a dedicated endpoint
commands.chatgptRole: What ChatGPT should see after every mutate — compact, not the full JSON dump

commands.intent: List worlds for this household (id, name, revision, focused?)

commands.intent: Create a new empty world for the household (game, Studio, or Zeus)

inputs.name: string

commands.intent: Load a specific world by id into the agent/editor
commands.chatgptRole: Inspect a non-focused world without stealing focus

commands.intent: Upsert a specific world by id

commands.intent: Erase live world back to starter scaffold (Studio Erase world)
commands.chatgptRole: Destructive; require explicit confirm in chat

outputs: editor state: scenes layout, selection, notice

commands.intent: Select a scene on the map / details record
commands.chatgptRole: Optional chrome; agents usually mutate by id without focus

commands.intent: Fit/arrange/zoom the world graph camera

commands.intent: Remove a scene and clean travel edges/places

commands.intent: Turn plain language into a Midjourney scene-plate prompt
commands.chatgptRole: Either ChatGPT writes the MJ prompt itself, or calls this for house style rules

commands.chatgptRole: Secondary; human usually pastes Suno results

commands.intent: Resolve a semantic plate id to image bytes/URL for preview
commands.chatgptRole: Preview registry art; remote https plates skip this

commands.intent: Validate walkability, missing plates/songs, placeholders
commands.chatgptRole: Agent self-check before put

commands.intent: Append invent/prompt/sample events to document.creative trail
commands.transport: Studio ensureCreative; preserved on PUT if client omits creative
commands.chatgptRole: Provenance for chat-authored scenes

commands.intent: Confirm Studio/household identity
commands.chatgptRole: Session sanity; not for children

commands.intent: Upload image/audio/model bytes to Game Asset registry under a semantic key
commands.transport: Game Asset API v1 (admin key server-side); Studio does not yet publish from the browser for chat plates
commands.chatgptRole: Promote a Midjourney CDN URL into a durable registry key before ship, if desired

commands.intent: Read live session JSON (beat, hud, flags, vars, actors)
commands.transport: GET /api/v1/live/{worldId} (planned); until then Studio/iPad local live blob
commands.chatgptRole: Orient before narrating; include vars

commands.intent: Merge-patch live session (hud, beat, flags, soft highlights)
commands.chatgptRole: Stage directions; not for counters — use vars.apply

commands.intent: Game reports a play event to Zeus (entered scene, tapped place)
commands.chatgptRole: Trigger narrative / vars ops from real play

commands.intent: Read counters/flags for a scope (session|player|world)
commands.transport: GET /api/v1/vars or embedded in session.get / player.state
commands.chatgptRole: Read before gating; never invent totals

commands.intent: Apply whitelisted ops and evaluate gates server-side; return authoritative vars + effects

inputs.scope: session|player|world (default session; per-op scope override allowed)
inputs.ops: [{op:inc|dec|set|add|min|max|clamp, key, by?, value?, min?, max?, scope?}]
inputs.gates: optional [{when: tiny expr, then: effect string[]}]

commands.transport: POST /api/v1/vars/apply — server is calculator; GPT never does mental math
commands.chatgptRole: Primary tool for counters, trust meters, story gates. Narrate from response only.
commands.notes: Bridge key gems to PlayerState.gems when scope=player. Tiny when forms only: key>=n, flag==true|false, key==string. See GPT_DUNGEON_MASTER_PRIMER.md §4.

commands.intent: Register a var key (type, default, clamp, scope) before first use
commands.chatgptRole: Optional schema for story-specific counters

recommendedMcpV1.goal: Dungeon master: create/focus worlds, full editor, live session R/W, server-side vars
recommendedMcpV1.implementationNote: Game and Studio must call world.create + world.set_current (player/editor focus). Prefer patch helpers that load focused world → mutate one scene/place → put with expectedRevision → return world.describe. Session/vars are scoped to focused worldId. Counters use vars.apply only. UI proposals follow docs/GPT_DUNGEON_MASTER_PRIMER.md §6.

turns: Human: new story / paste Midjourney link / kid taps a POI / switch world
Agent: world.list → world.create? → world.set_current → world.describe + session.get / vars.get
Human: confirm beat / paste plate URL
Agent: vars.apply (inc/gates) → session HUD effects from response
Agent: world.lint → world.put_current → return worldId + revision + vars delta
Human: check Studio map / iPad focus / live HUD
